simulation_boundaries: No actual OAuth or authentication server.
No payment processing, wallet authorization, actual invoice, carrier tracking, or merchant order submission.

Profiles, orders, bookings and demo stock live only in React memory.
Local storage only contains sanitized cart selections and locale/currency preferences.
